The background warping is minor but noticeable. The experts did not contradict these findings; the topology auditor found a clean mask (high confidence), which suggests the *shape* is coherent, but doesn't rule out internal texture artifacts. The perceptual auditor found no global distortions, which aligns with the local nature of the detected issues.
